g.text: Uno logical pin map: TX to Uno D0; RX to Uno D1. J1 pin map: module TX goes to Uno D0/RX; module RX is driven from D1/TX through a 5 V-to-3.3 V translator.

g.text: Use a separate regulated 3.3 V source sized for radio peaks. A bare ESP8266 is not 5 V tolerant. Physical Wi-Fi link was not tested.
